post.title: Feeling amazed by this video
post.description: I really like Design Theory channels opinions and reflections.
post.html: This video talks about how minimalism, simplicity in design, and now AI, are all driving us towards mediocrity. Intentionality is going to make us distinct from slop farms, we FEEL there we are! It was really tongue in the cheek to sees how Cyberpunk 2077 has better designs than whatever current car industry is coming up with.
